items.label: Powerful 13th Gen Intel Core Performance
items.value: Experience desktop-level speed with the latest Intel Core i7-13620H processor (10 Cores: 6P+4E, up to 4.9GHz, 24MB Cache). Perfectly equipped for demanding business tasks, multitasking, academic research, and light creative work—all in a portable, lightweight chassis.

items.label: Vivid 15.3" WUXGA Display
items.value: Immerse yourself in crisp, clear visuals on the 15.3" WUXGA (1920x1200) IPS anti-glare display with 300 nits brightness and 45% NTSC. The 16:10 aspect ratio offers more vertical space for documents and browsing, ideal for productivity and entertainment.

items.label: Massive Memory & Blazing-Fast Storage
items.value: Tackle heavy workloads with 24GB of high-speed DDR5 RAM and a 1TB PCIe NVMe M.2 SSD. Enjoy seamless multitasking, rapid boot-ups, and near-instant access to files, apps, and large projects without lag.

items.label: Advanced Connectivity & Ports
items.value: Stay connected with Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax 2x2) and Bluetooth 5.2. Versatile I/O includes 2x USB-A (5Gbps), 1x USB-C (5Gbps with PD 3.0 & DP 1.2), HDMI 1.4, headphone jack, SD card reader, and power connector—ideal for peripherals and dual-monitor setups.

items.label: Sleek Design with Business-Ready Features
items.value: Finished in Luna Grey, this lightweight laptop (approx. 3.51 lbs) features a full-size keyboard with numeric keypad for efficient data entry, plus a 720p webcam with physical privacy shutter. Comes with Windows 11 Home and built for professionals, students, and everyday productivity.
